counting: Five substantive mathematical approach families, consolidated in RESULT.md; source triage and tool calls are not separate approaches.
independence: Single authoring worker. Fresh adversarial review requested separately; no independent proof claim is made.

turns.work: Proper polynomial pullbacks over a Jordan disc; the degree and ramification sums force one component.
turns.outcome: Complete proof for polynomials; no finite degree budget for transcendental maps.

turns.work: Apply the precisely checked BFR2015 Proposition 2.9; prove immediate attracting basins are simply connected and derive the restricted dynamical corollary.
turns.outcome: Compact closed singular set inside the basin is an extra hypothesis; arbitrary regions need an appropriate simply connected subdomain.

turns.work: Analyse a transitive covering action in finite type and test continuation across singular accumulation points.
turns.outcome: No uniform homotopy-lifting theorem was proved over the complement of only the actual critical/asymptotic values.

turns.work: Test z^n, exp(z), and exp(z)+z; distinguish genuine disconnected-preimage controls from cases excluded by the hypothesis.
turns.outcome: No entire map and region satisfying all hypotheses with disconnected full preimage were constructed.

turns.work: Derive the equivalence with eventual capture of every component of every trapping-disc pullback.
turns.outcome: Pointwise capture of each singular value does not prove capture of every pullback component.
